description: This file implements the VoiceControl plugin for the WPEFramework, providing JSON-RPC methods and event handling for voice session management, configuration, and messaging, interfacing with IARM bus events and external modules.

classes.name: VoiceControl
classes.description: Main plugin class implementing voice control functionalities, event handling, and JSON-RPC method registration.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the plugin, sets up IARM event handlers, and retrieves PII masking setting.

methods.name: Deinitialize
methods.description: Cleans up resources and unregisters event handlers.

methods.name: InitializeIARM
methods.description: Initializes IARM bus connection and registers event handlers.

methods.name: DeinitializeIARM
methods.description: Removes IARM event handlers and cleans up.

methods.name: voiceEventHandler
methods.description: Static callback for handling IARM events, delegates to instance method.

methods.name: iarmEventHandler
methods.description: Handles specific IARM events related to voice sessions and streams.

methods.name: getApiVersionNumber
methods.description: Returns the current API version number.

methods.name: getMaskPii_
methods.description: Retrieves the current PII masking setting by calling voiceStatus.

methods.name: voiceStatus
methods.description: Queries the current voice status and configuration via IARM bus.

methods.name: configureVoice
methods.description: Configures voice settings via IARM bus call.

methods.name: setVoiceInit
methods.description: Initializes voice session settings via IARM bus call.

methods.name: sendVoiceMessage
methods.description: Sends a voice message command via IARM bus.

methods.name: voiceSessionByText
methods.description: Deprecated method to start voice session by text transcription.

methods.name: voiceSessionTypes
methods.description: Retrieves available voice session types via IARM bus.

methods.name: voiceSessionRequest
methods.description: Requests a new voice session via IARM bus.

methods.name: voiceSessionTerminate
methods.description: Terminates an active voice session via IARM bus.

methods.name: voiceSessionAudioStreamStart
methods.description: Starts audio streaming for a voice session via IARM bus.

methods.name: onSessionBegin
methods.description: Handles session begin event and notifies clients.

methods.name: onStreamBegin
methods.description: Handles stream begin event and notifies clients.

methods.name: onKeywordVerification
methods.description: Handles keyword verification event and notifies clients.

methods.name: onServerMessage
methods.description: Handles server message event and notifies clients.

methods.name: onStreamEnd
methods.description: Handles stream end event and notifies clients.

methods.name: onSessionEnd
methods.description: Handles session end event and notifies clients.

methods.name: setApiVersionNumber
methods.description: Sets the API version number.

methods.name: sendNotify_
methods.description: Sends notification, masking parameters if configured.
